fixes: Failure text names the ERR_PNPM_* line, DSH's failure kind and DSH's log path, not the first output line.
Installed is the exact version the Profile records (Starter and profile-added packages), with node_modules as the fallback, so files a failed install leaves are not taken for an update.
The Host keeps how the last update ended (VersionStatus.lastUpdate); the reopened dialog shows that success or error.
Packages updated from the dialog are compared with the version they replaced; one put back waits for nothing.
Status reopens the dialog only after the Host answers, and drops the record once DSH runs the updated version with nothing pending.
